name: DENC11
title: DEN.C11 ClinicalLab evaluation
description: Questionnaire for the DEN.C11 ClinicalLab evaluation data elements, based on the source data dictionary.

text.div:
Implementation notes and pending items

This Questionnaire represents the six hematocrit evaluation questions in source order. The narrative records modeling decisions and unresolved source details; it is not additional questionnaire content.

  • Each evaluation question is marked Select one. Its Required cell is blank, so all six are optional; repeats are false. The response option rows are marked Required=O and are choices under their parent question, not separate questions.
  • The source labels identify first through sixth evaluations but provide no measurement date/time, numeric hematocrit result, units, reference range, or rule linking a rising/falling status to prior values. The profile stores only the selected coded status and ordinal evaluation code; no time, numeric result, unit, or comparison rule is added.
  • The workbook lists LOINC 20570-8 as “Best Fit” for follow-up status options. It identifies a hematocrit measurement, not a rising/falling/normal-stable status; mappings are retained as relatedto candidates for review.
  • The workbook supplies SNOMED CT 365618006 for both rising and falling hematocrit, with the broad display “Finding of hematocrit - packed cell volume level (finding)” and a Best Fit note. The normal/stable status uses 409683007. These are candidate mappings requiring terminology review. The first-question “Normal hematocrit” option has no SNOMED code and remains locally coded.
  • ICD-10, ICD-11, and ICF cells are blank or marked not classifiable; no target mappings are asserted. No skip logic, conditional requirements, or additional clinical rules are supplied.
  • Answers may be represented as BR-Core Observations as an implementation choice. Observation status and Patient context must come from the implementing workflow. QuestionnaireResponse remains the direct record of the form answer.
